headline: Record revenue and one-off gain lift profit; guide raised
summary_short: Revenue net of interest expense was a record $20.1B, up 9% y/y, and EPS was $5.42 ($4.68 adjusted, up 13%); full-year EPS guidance was raised to $18.30-$18.60.
summary_long: Net income of $3.7B includes a $982M pre-tax ($751M after-tax) gain on the sale of the stake in Global Business Travel Group, net of restructuring funding. Provisions for credit losses fell to $1.0B from $1.3B on a reserve release, and the net write-off rate was 1.8% versus 1.9%. Expenses rose 9% to $14.5B. The effective tax rate was 18.1% versus 24.1%. Adjusted full-year EPS guidance is $17.60-$17.90.
confidence_notes: Revenue is total revenues net of interest expense from the release ($20,062M); the shard's SEC revenue line ($11,232M) is a narrower contract-revenue tag and is not used. Prior-year comparisons are from the release's own YoY column. Adjusted EPS excludes the GBTG gain net of restructuring and is non-GAAP.

drivers.explanation: Higher Card Member spending, increased net interest income from card balance growth, and strong card fee growth.
Includes a $751 million after-tax gain on the sale of the GBTG equity interest and a lower tax rate from discrete prior-period tax resolutions.
Growth of 31% versus 13% adjusted shows the GBTG gain accounts for most of the gap; share count also fell 3%.
CEO points to strength in billings, new acquisitions, Card Member retention and excellent credit quality.
